description: Update the connected user's PowPow nickname or bio. Nickname 1-20 characters, bio up to 200 characters; you may change both at once but must pass at least one (empty string clears the bio). Changes take effect site-wide immediately. The avatar cannot be changed here — send the user to in-app settings.

bio.description: New bio, up to 200 characters. Empty string clears it

nickname.description: New nickname, 1-20 characters. Omit to keep it unchanged
